blockers.title: A course heading that prints an age range becomes a ready student with no warning. This is a regression from 5c1e029
blockers.scenario: Probes round5/heading.probe A1/A2 and baseline.probe. Any line that matches 'N anni' returns 'row' before any heading test. Tested sheets: 'Corso Deriva 8-12 anni' above three students, text-only and as a laid-out TSV. The result was surname Corso, given name Deriva, age 12 from '12 anni', sex female from -a, no rowWarning, and candidateIsReady true after the sheet's name-order vote. 'CORSO VELA 10-14 ANNI' and 'Settimana Deriva 12 anni' behave the same way. The row saves with the roster on 'Aggiungi N allievi', and nothing on screen marks it. At 5c1e029 isObviousNonStudentLine skipped the line: the baseline gives the three students only. The repository's own test uses 'Allievi (8-12 anni)' as a heading, so age ranges in headings are an expected form. Only a two-word leading part whose second word suggests a sex becomes ready. Three words stay blocked on the split. The self-review says the five private photos have no extra ready row, so the owner's sheets do not show this.
blockers.suggestedFix: In the printed-age branch, when the first name-cell word (or the first leading word without a layout) matches NON_STUDENT_LINE_PATTERN, return 'row-led-by-heading-word', as the layout branch does. The row is then kept but marked possible-heading, so a real 'Sabato Marco 12 anni' still survives and needs one Controlla. Add a test that 'Corso Deriva 8-12 anni' is never ready.

blockers.title: QUESTIONS question 1 tells the owner that §13 and check:repository protect pre-rewrite copies. The copies it names have neither
blockers.scenario: Codex's worktree .codex/worktrees/ux1-pages-promotion is detached at fcdf42f. That commit descends from v0.2.0 (8e9b2b7), a ref the plan (04:291-293) says contained real student data. Read-only check: `git show fcdf42f:AGENTS.md` has no rewrite rule, and `git show fcdf42f:scripts/check-repository.mjs` has no guard (grep: 0). In the new tree the guard also passes silently when .evidence/F1/history-rewrite.json is absent (verified: check:repository PASS today). So an agent session in that worktree reads no rule, `npm run check:repository` passes there, and a branch pushed from it republishes the old history. CI on that branch runs the old script and passes. CI also runs only after the push, so it can report a publication but cannot stop it. The paragraph says '§13 tells both agents never to work from a pre-rewrite copy' and 'check:repository … fails when the checked-out history contains a pre-rewrite commit'. Both are false for the copies the same paragraph asks the owner to delete, and they make that deletion look like a formality.
blockers.suggestedFix: Reword. The rule and the check exist only in copies that already hold the rewritten history: a fresh clone, or an old copy after it has merged the rewritten line, where the check then fails. A copy that has not fetched the rewrite has neither, and must be deleted before any agent session runs in it. CI reports after a push and cannot prevent one. Put 'delete the Codex worktree and refs/codex/* before the next Codex session' in the plan's 'Where this cycle stands' as a precondition for UG2.

importantFindings.title: The F1F-3 fix makes a digit-free 'Istruttore …' line start the staff section, so every student below it vanishes
importantFindings.location: src/capabilities/studentScan.ts:197-198,1107-1111 (the row prefix at 201-202 no longer runs on such lines); src/capabilities/studentScan.test.ts:1043-1057
importantFindings.scenario: Probes round5/parser S1/S2 and baseline.probe. (a) 'Elenco partecipanti / Istruttore: Verdani Luca / 3 students' (text-only and laid-out) gives 0 candidates and unsuitable. The baseline and the round-4 tree kept all 3. (b) Case: a student row, then 'Istruttore Verdani Luca', then two more student rows. Only the first student is read. The other two vanish with no notice. The baseline kept all 3. A singular 'Istruttore X' line names one staff member, which PERSONNEL_ROW_PREFIX_PATTERN exists to skip alone. The original SC-11 fix asked for a section start only on a line with no name cell. The feminine 'Istruttrice: …' already behaved this way at 5c1e029. The owner's photos are said to be unchanged.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Start the staff section only on a line with no name cell: the keyword alone or with non-name words (Istruttori, Personale, Staff, Assistenti). Never start it when two or more name words follow the keyword. Treat a singular 'Istruttore/Istruttrice/Assistente X' line as a staff row and skip it alone. Add tests for such a line above and between students.

qolFindings.title: The F1F-2 rule 'mark only after a candidate exists' misfires in both directions
qolFindings.scenario: Probes round5/parser S3/S3b/S4. (a) 'Personale al 29/08/2026' or 'Istruttori di turno tel. 3331234567' at the top, then staff rows without role codes, then 'Allievi'. The staff rows become ready students with no warning. The baseline dropped them and round 4 marked them. (b) A stray row read above a contact line marks every student possible-staff again. An example is a subtitle such as 'Registro di prova dati inventati', which the synthetic sheet prints. SC-11 says 'below the first student read', but the code counts any row read.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Mark rows after a staff mention only when they read as adults (18 or older at course start), or count only candidates that have a date or an age.

qolFindings.title: The pre-rewrite guard fails open
qolFindings.scenario: A missing history-rewrite.json passes silently, and AGENTS.md §6 step 15's evidence sweep could remove it. Any entry that is not a resolvable full id also counts as 'not an ancestor': an object entry, a short or ambiguous id, or a typo. The main checkout will hold old and new objects together. The 'tested both ways' claim has no committed test.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Require /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/ entries. Use `git cat-file -e` to tell 'missing' from 'not an ancestor'. Once the rewrite exists, fail when the file is missing on a HEAD that descends from the rewrite commit. Add a committed self-test.

qolFindings.title: The next-steps bullet on heading-word names is still broader than the code
qolFindings.scenario: Probes round5/parser R1/R2, on a laid-out table with the age word misread. 'Sabato Wu' (one readable name word) and 'Sabato Marco … 01/02/2074' (birth year misread 1→7) both vanish. The bullet says a table row with a date or telephone is kept and dropped only for a course or print date.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Add 'or when fewer than two name words are read, or the birth year is misread into the last four years or the future'.
